svg.title: Shots and VFX
svg.desc: Ten shot and impact effect studies with weapons doc names, and the damage type badges

text.font-family: Fredoka, 'Baloo 2', Nunito, 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif
Nunito, Fredoka, 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif

svg.text: Shot names follow 01-weapons. The fill is the damage type; a thin rim shows the owner. Fire is ember red with a gold core. Nothing is orange or team blue.
